e.title: **一次**只改表现层**的版本更新：**逐字写明「**没有一项分析输入发生变化**」****：Zenodo 记录 `10.5281/zenodo.22656480`（169 个社区健康保险方案、**38 国）——**⭐ 逐字**「**No analytical input changed: the registry, the three pillar datasets, the derived country- and scheme-level datasets, and all eleven analysis scripts are byte-identical to version 4.0.2**」**；**⭐ 而**新脚本**在画图前先校验输入文件的 md5**，**逐字**「**refuses to run on any other data vintage**」**；**⭐ 旧脚本与旧图**原样保留**，**当作**上一版记录****
e.title_en: A version update of a replication package that changes only the presentation layer while stating verbatim that no analytical input changed and that the registry, three pillar datasets, derived datasets and all eleven analysis scripts are byte-identical to the previous version, where the new figure script verifies input checksums before drawing and refuses to run on any other data vintage.
e.title_hk: **一次**只改表現層**的版本更新：**逐字寫明「**沒有一項分析輸入發生變化**」****：Zenodo 記錄 `10.5281/zenodo.22656480`（169 個社區健康保險方案、**38 國）——**⭐ 逐字**「**No analytical input changed: the registry, the three pillar datasets, the derived country- and scheme-level datasets, and all eleven analysis scripts are byte-identical to version 4.0.2**」**；**⭐ 而**新腳本**在畫圖前先校驗輸入檔的 md5**，**逐字**「**refuses to run on any other data vintage**」**；**⭐ 舊腳本與舊圖**原樣保留****。
e.summary: **cbhi-viability-replication**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22656480`**）**是一份**研究报告的复现仓库****——**逐字标题为**「**Replication repository for Measuring What Matters for the Viability of Inclusive Insurance: Behavioural Diagnostics from 169 Community-Based Health Insurance Schemes Across 38 Countries**」**，**创建者逐字为** Dror, David M.**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-08**、**类型 dataset**、**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**单一文件 **`GPRI_R3_v320_deposit_v410_FINAL.zip`（**2,251,748 字节**）**；**⭐ 描述字段里放的**不是摘要，**而是这一版的**改动说明**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：说清改了什么**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **逐字声明「**没有一项分析输入发生变化**」并列出**哪些东西**逐字节相同****（**登记表、**三个支柱数据集、**派生国家与方案层数据集、**十一个分析脚本**）**；**② **新绘图脚本在画图**之前**先校验输入文件的 **md5**，**并**拒绝在其它数据版本上运行****；**③ **旧脚本与旧图**不删而是**原样保留为上一版记录****；**④ **一份**表号映射文档**说明**管线文件名与论文表号**如何对应**，**并**指出一处**规格差异（**未分解 vs 已分解**）**且**两者 **R² 同为 **0.517****。**⚠️ 本次未下载该压缩包。
e.summary_hk: **cbhi-viability-replication**（Zenodo 記錄 **`10.5281/zenodo.22656480`**）**是一份**研究報告的複現倉庫****——**逐字標題為**「**Replication repository for Measuring What Matters for the Viability of Inclusive Insurance: Behavioural Diagnostics from 169 Community-Based Health Insurance Schemes Across 38 Countries**」**，**創建者逐字為** Dror, David M.**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-09-08**、**類型 dataset**、**許可 CC-BY-4.0**、**單一檔案 **`GPRI_R3_v320_deposit_v410_FINAL.zip`（**2,251,748 位元組**）**；**⭐ 描述欄位裡放的**不是摘要，**而是這一版的**改動說明**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**登記處紀律：說清改了什么**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **逐字聲明「**沒有一項分析輸入發生變化**」並列出**哪些東西**逐位元組相同****；**② **新繪圖腳本在畫圖**之前**先校驗輸入檔的 md5**，**並**拒絕在其它資料版本上運行****；**③ **舊腳本與舊圖**不刪而是**原樣保留為上一版記錄****；**④ **一份**表號映射文檔**說明**管線檔名與論文表號**如何對應**，**並**指出一處**規格差異**且**兩者 R² 同為 0.517****。**⚠️ 本次未下載該壓縮包。
e.summary_en: The Zenodo record cbhi-viability-replication **is a replication repository for a study of the viability of inclusive insurance based on behavioural diagnostics from one hundred and sixty-nine community-based health insurance schemes across thirty-eight countries**. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-08**, **registered as a dataset**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, with a single package file of about two point two five megabytes, and a description field that holds the version change note rather than an abstract. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here stating exactly what changed**, and **four things are worth reading: the note states verbatim that no analytical input changed and names the registry, the three pillar datasets, the derived country and scheme level datasets and all eleven analysis scripts as byte-identical to the previous version; the new figure script verifies the checksums of its two input files before drawing and refuses to run on any other data vintage; the previous script and the previous figures are retained unchanged as the previous record rather than deleted; and a table-numbering document maps pipeline file names to manuscript table numbers and records one specification difference where both variants give the same coefficient of determination**. **The archive was not downloaded this round.**
e.body:
**cbhi-viability-replication**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22656480`**）**是一份**研究报告的复现仓库****——**逐字标题为**「**Replication repository for Measuring What Matters for the Viability of Inclusive Insurance: Behavioural Diagnostics from 169 Community-Based Health Insurance Schemes Across 38 Countries**」**，**创建者逐字为** Dror, David M.**。**本次实测**：**创建 2026-09-08**、**类型 dataset**、**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**单一文件 **`GPRI_R3_v320_deposit_v410_FINAL.zip`（**2,251,748 字节**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：说清改了什么**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Zenodo API 元数据与记录描述实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一次「**只改表现层**」的更新被逐字说清**——**记录描述逐字为**：**「**Version 4.1.0 accompanies manuscript v3.20 at revision round 3. **No analytical input changed**: the registry, the three pillar datasets, the derived country- and scheme-level datasets, and **all eleven analysis scripts are byte-identical to version 4.0.2**. The changes are presentational and are listed in `docs/CHANGELOG.md`.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**「**改了什么**」与「**没改什么**」**同时写出来**，**而**「**没改**」那一侧**是**可验证的**（**逐字节相同**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 350 轮「**来源与生成物**」、第 353 轮「**同源多形**」同向**：**当一份存档**换了版本号时，**读者最需要知道的是**分析结论有没有变**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 新脚本在**画图之前先校验输入文件的 md5****——**逐字**：**「**Added: `scripts/05b_figures_corrected_v1_7.R`, which **supersedes** `scripts/05_figures.R` for the published figures. It corrects the internal title of Figure 1, which read CHI where the manuscript uses CBHI; removes an annotation in Figure 3 that overprinted a bar label; removes an underscore from the Figure 3 pillar axis; and reduces the two likelihood-ratio statements in Figure 1 Panel B to their p-values, the full statements having moved to the manuscript figure caption.**」**——**逐字續**「**Before drawing it verifies the md5 of both input files and refuses to run on any other data vintage.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一句值得单独抄**：**⭐ 即**「**拒绝在别的数据版本上运行**」**——**⭐ 这是一种**把「**这张图是按哪一版数据画的**」**变成**机器约束**的做法**；**⭐ 与之对照**：**很多复现包**只说明**它用了哪份数据**，**而**不阻止**你**拿别的数据去画**。**⭐⭐ ③ 输出规格被写到**排版层面****——**逐字**：**「**It writes PDF, TIFF at 600 dpi with LZW compression, and PNG at 600 dpi, and **sizes the type so that in-panel labelling remains at 8.7 points after resizing to one text column width**.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**「**字体在缩到单栏宽后仍是 8.7 磅**」**是**投稿排版要求**，**而**它**被写进了复现说明**——**⭐ 即**图的**可复现**包括**排版细节**。**⭐⭐ ④ 旧件**不删，**而是**原样保留为上一版记录****——**逐字**：**「**Added: `outputs/figures_v2/`, holding the three corrected figures as submitted to the journal. **`outputs/figures/` and `scripts/05_figures.R` are retained unchanged as the previous record.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处与第 ① 点是同一种纪律**：**⭐ 即**被取代的东西**留在原处**，**以便**任何人核对**「**哪个版本对应哪次投稿**」。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 一处**规格与表号的差异被主动记下**，**且**给出**两者同值**的结果**——**逐字**：**「**Added: `docs/TABLE_NUMBERING_R3.md`, mapping the pipeline output file names, which keep their original numbering, to the manuscript table numbers from revision 3 onward, where Box 1 became Table 1, and the six existing tables moved up by one. **The same file records that `outputs/tables/table3_country_ols.csv` carries the undecomposed Combined specification while the manuscript reports the decomposed one introduced at v3.16, both giving R2 = 0.517, with `scripts/08_audit_numerical_claims.R` auditing the printed values.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处尤其值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**文件里的规格与论文里的规格不同**」**被写明**，**而且**顺带给出**两者结果相同（**R² **0.517****）**——**⭐ 这正是**审稿场景**里最需要的一句话**：**读者不必自己发现差异，**也不必因此怀疑结论**；**⭐ 而**它**还指出**有一个脚本**专门审计论文中印出的数值**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 完整性清单覆盖**包内全部文件****——**逐字**：**「**Added: `MANIFEST_MD5_v3_20.csv`, an MD5 and byte-size manifest of **all 65 files**.**」**。**⭐ 即**这一版**对包内**65 个文件**给出了**md5 与字节数**——**⭐ 与第 ② 点的**输入校验**合起来**，**形成**内外两层校验**（**清单对全包，**脚本对输入**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 研究对象与关键词被写明**——**逐字关键词含** `inclusive insurance`、`community health insurance`、`behavioural diagnostics`、`replication data`、`microinsurance`、`cluster-robust standard errors`、`Trinity Law of cooperative institutions`、`Dual Benefit`、`cooperative institutions`、`community-based health insurance schemes`、`scheme sustainability`、`Low- and Middle Income Countries`、`multiplicative model`、`Universal Health Coverage`**；**⭐ 即**样本规模（**169 个方案、**38 国**）**写在标题里**，**而**方法关键词（**聚类稳健标准误、**乘法模型**）**写在关键词里**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 一处**体例上的观察**（本次实测）**——**⭐ 该记录的**描述字段**放的不是研究摘要，**而是**这一版的改动说明**（**逐字以版本号与稿件版本开头**）**；**⭐ 本词条认为这一点值得记**：**⭐ 即**在登记处里，**「**这一版改了什么**」**与「**这项研究是什么**」**是两个字段**，**而**这里**只填了前者**——**⭐ 读者要了解研究本身**需要**打开包内的文档**；**⭐ 本词条**如实记录而不评判**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[microinsurance-network]]、**[[a2ii]] 覆盖小额保险的行业组织与出版物**，**[[club-vita]] 覆盖微保精算基础数据**，**[[openimis]] 覆盖开源微保管理系统**，**[[who-gho]]、**[[worldbank-data]] 覆盖全球卫生与发展指标**，**[[synthetic-resdac-claims]] 覆盖合成理赔数据**，**[[mortality-analysis-provenance]] 覆盖「**证据分四栏 ＋ 机器不能签字**」的做法**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一次**只改表现层**的版本更新：**逐字声明分析输入逐字节未变 ＋ **绘图脚本校验输入 md5 并拒绝其它数据版本 ＋ **旧件原样保留 ＋ **表号与规格差异主动写明**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[mortality-analysis-provenance]]、[[microinsurance-network]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① **版本更新要同时说明「**改了什么**」与「**没改什么**」**；**② **绘图或派生脚本**在动手前**校验输入指纹**，**并可**拒绝其它数据版本**；**③ **被取代的脚本与产物**原样保留**，**标注为上一版记录**；**④ **文件名与论文编号**不一致时**给一张映射表**；**⑤ **发现规格差异**就写下来**，**并**给出两者结果**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载该压缩包**（**未解包、**未读任何数据集或脚本、**未复算任何模型或图形**），**故**不主张**其 169 个方案、**38 国、**R² **0.517** 或任何其它数值结果**；**⭐ 本词条所述的一切**都来自**该记录的**描述字段与元数据**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核实**「**逐字节相同**」这一断言**（**⭐ 需要**下载两个版本并比对**才能确认**）**；**也未核实** `MANIFEST_MD5_v3_20.csv` **是否真的覆盖 65 个文件**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实** `docs/CHANGELOG.md` **的实际内容**（**⭐ 描述称改动列于其中，**本次未读**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实** `scripts/08_audit_numerical_claims.R` **的审计范围与结果**；**也未核实**「**未分解与已分解规格**」**两者结果相同**这一说法**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**该研究**是否已发表、**发表在哪、**以及该复现包对应哪一轮审稿**（**⭐ 描述称** manuscript v3.20、**revision round 3**，**但**本次未查证**）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**作者身份与机构**（**记录只给出 **Dror, David M.**）**；**也未核实**其与**任何机构或期刊**的关系**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实** 169／38 **这两个数字的口径**（**⭐ 即**「**方案**」与「**国家**」**如何计数**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ **许可**为** CC-BY-4.0**（**须署名**）**；**⭐ 而**其数据来源**（**社区健康保险方案的登记表**）**是否**另有第三方权利**，**本条**未核实**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**创建于 **2026-09-08**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**，**⭐ 无需窗口例外说明**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该包是**研究复现材料**，**不得**当作任何保险方案可持续性的评估结论**。
e.body_hk:
**cbhi-viability-replication**（Zenodo 記錄 **`10.5281/zenodo.22656480`**）**是一份**研究報告的複現倉庫****——**逐字標題為**「**Replication repository for Measuring What Matters for the Viability of Inclusive Insurance: Behavioural Diagnostics from 169 Community-Based Health Insurance Schemes Across 38 Countries**」**，**創建者逐字為** Dror, David M.**。**本次實測**：**建立 2026-09-08**、**類型 dataset**、**許可 CC-BY-4.0**、**單一檔案 **`GPRI_R3_v320_deposit_v410_FINAL.zip`（**2,251,748 位元組**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**登記處紀律：說清改了什么**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Zenodo API 元資料與記錄描述實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 一次「**只改表現層**」的更新被逐字說清****——**逐字**「**Version 4.1.0 accompanies manuscript v3.20 at revision round 3. No analytical input changed: the registry, the three pillar datasets, the derived country- and scheme-level datasets, and all eleven analysis scripts are byte-identical to version 4.0.2. The changes are presentational and are listed in `docs/CHANGELOG.md`.**」**——**⭐ 即**「**改了什么**」與「**沒改什么**」**同時寫出**，**而**「**沒改**」那一側**是**可驗證的**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 新腳本在**畫圖之前先校驗輸入的 md5****——**逐字**「**Added: `scripts/05b_figures_corrected_v1_7.R`, which supersedes `scripts/05_figures.R` for the published figures. It corrects the internal title of Figure 1, which read CHI where the manuscript uses CBHI; removes an annotation in Figure 3 that overprinted a bar label; removes an underscore from the Figure 3 pillar axis; and reduces the two likelihood-ratio statements in Figure 1 Panel B to their p-values, the full statements having moved to the manuscript figure caption.**」**——**逐字**「**Before drawing it verifies the md5 of both input files and refuses to run on any other data vintage.**」**——**⭐ 即**把「**這張圖是按哪一版資料畫的**」**變成機器約束**。**⭐⭐ ③ 輸出規格寫到**排版層面****——**逐字**「**It writes PDF, TIFF at 600 dpi with LZW compression, and PNG at 600 dpi, and sizes the type so that in-panel labelling remains at 8.7 points after resizing to one text column width.**」**。**⭐⭐ ④ 舊件**不刪，**原樣保留為上一版記錄****——**逐字**「**Added: `outputs/figures_v2/`, holding the three corrected figures as submitted to the journal. `outputs/figures/` and `scripts/05_figures.R` are retained unchanged as the previous record.**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ ⑤ 一處**規格與表號差異被主動記下**，**並給出兩者同值**——**逐字**「**Added: `docs/TABLE_NUMBERING_R3.md`, mapping the pipeline output file names, which keep their original numbering, to the manuscript table numbers from revision 3 onward, where Box 1 became Table 1, and the six existing tables moved up by one. The same file records that `outputs/tables/table3_country_ols.csv` carries the undecomposed Combined specification while the manuscript reports the decomposed one introduced at v3.16, both giving R2 = 0.517, with `scripts/08_audit_numerical_claims.R` auditing the printed values.**」**——**⭐ 即**讀者不必自己發現差異，**也不必因此懷疑結論**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 完整性清單覆蓋**包內全部檔案****——**逐字**「**Added: `MANIFEST_MD5_v3_20.csv`, an MD5 and byte-size manifest of all 65 files.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 研究對象與關鍵詞**：**關鍵詞逐字含** inclusive insurance／community health insurance／behavioural diagnostics／replication data／microinsurance／cluster-robust standard errors／Trinity Law of cooperative institutions／Dual Benefit／scheme sustainability／Low- and Middle Income Countries／multiplicative model／Universal Health Coverage**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 一處**體例觀察**：**該記錄的**描述欄位放的不是研究摘要，**而是**這一版的改動說明****——**⭐ 即**「**這一版改了什麼**」與「**這項研究是什麼**」**是兩個欄位**，**這裡只填了前者**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 與池內條目的關係**：[[microinsurance-network]]、[[a2ii]]、[[club-vita]]、[[openimis]]、[[who-gho]]、[[worldbank-data]]、[[synthetic-resdac-claims]]、[[mortality-analysis-provenance]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**只改表現層的版本更新：逐字聲明分析輸入逐位元組未變＋繪圖腳本校驗輸入 md5 並拒絕其它資料版本＋舊件原樣保留＋表號與規格差異主動寫明**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[mortality-analysis-provenance]]、[[microinsurance-network]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 五點最值得借鑑**：**① **版本更新要同時說明「**改了什麼**」與「**沒改什麼**」**；**② **繪圖或派生腳本**動手前**校驗輸入指紋**；**③ **被取代的腳本與產物**原樣保留**；**④ **檔名與論文編號**不一致時給映射表**；**⑤ **發現規格差異就寫下來，**並給出兩者結果**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載該壓縮包**（**未解包、**未讀任何資料集或腳本、**未複算任何模型或圖形**），**不主張**其 169 個方案、**38 國、**R² 0.517 或任何其它數值結果**；**所述一切**都來自**該記錄的描述欄位與元資料**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核實**「**逐位元組相同**」這一斷言**（**需下載兩個版本比對**）**；**未核實** `MANIFEST_MD5_v3_20.csv` **是否真的覆蓋 65 個檔案**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實** `docs/CHANGELOG.md` **的實際內容**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實** `scripts/08_audit_numerical_claims.R` **的審計範圍與結果**；**未核實**「**未分解與已分解規格**」**兩者結果相同**這一說法**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**該研究**是否已發表、**發表在哪、**對應哪一輪審稿**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**作者身份與機構**（**記錄只給出 Dror, David M.**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實** 169／38 **這兩個數字的口徑**。**⑧ ⚠️ 許可為 CC-BY-4.0**（**須署名**）**；**其資料來源是否另有第三方權利**，**本條未核實**。**⑨ ⚠️ 建立於 2026-09-08（**窗口之內**）**，**無需窗口例外說明**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該包是**研究複現材料**，**不得**當作任何保險方案可持續性的評估結論**。
e.body_en:
The Zenodo record cbhi-viability-replication **is a replication repository for a study of the viability of inclusive insurance**, titled as behavioural diagnostics from one hundred and sixty-nine community-based health insurance schemes across thirty-eight countries, credited to a single named creator. **Measured this round**: **created 2026-09-08**, **registered as a dataset**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, with a single package file of about two point two five megabytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here stating exactly what changed.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata and the record description**: **first, an update that changes only the presentation layer is stated clause by clause**: verbatim, version 4.1.0 accompanies manuscript v3.20 at revision round three, no analytical input changed, the registry, the three pillar datasets, the derived country and scheme level datasets and all eleven analysis scripts are byte-identical to version 4.0.2, and the changes are presentational and listed in a changelog. **What changed and what did not change are stated together, and the unchanged side is the verifiable one, which is exactly what a reader needs when a deposit changes version number.** **Second, the new figure script verifies checksums before drawing**: verbatim, the added script supersedes the earlier figure script for the published figures and corrects four things, namely an internal figure title that read one abbreviation where the manuscript uses another, an annotation that overprinted a bar label, a stray underscore on an axis, and two likelihood-ratio statements reduced to their p-values with the full statements moved to the caption, and **before drawing it verifies the checksum of both input files and refuses to run on any other data vintage**. **Refusing to run on another vintage turns which version of the data a figure was drawn from into a machine constraint rather than a note.** **Third, the output specification reaches the typography level**: verbatim, it writes PDF, TIFF at six hundred dots per inch with LZW compression and PNG at six hundred dots per inch, and sizes the type so that in-panel labelling remains at eight point seven points after resizing to one text column width. **Figure reproducibility therefore includes the typesetting requirement.** **Fourth, superseded artefacts are retained rather than deleted**: verbatim, a new directory holds the three corrected figures as submitted to the journal, while the previous figure directory and the previous figure script are retained unchanged as the previous record. **The thing that was replaced stays where it was, so anyone can check which version corresponds to which submission.** **Fifth, one specification and numbering difference is recorded, with the result given**: verbatim, an added document maps pipeline output file names, which keep their original numbering, to the manuscript table numbers from revision three onward, where a box became the first table and the six existing tables moved up by one, and the same document records that one output table carries the undecomposed combined specification while the manuscript reports the decomposed one introduced at an earlier version, both giving the same coefficient of determination, with a separate script auditing the printed values. **A reader therefore does not have to discover the difference, and does not have to doubt the conclusion because of it.** **Sixth, a completeness manifest covers the whole package**: verbatim, an added manifest gives checksums and byte sizes for all sixty-five files, which together with the input check inside the figure script forms two layers of verification. **Seventh, the subject matter and keywords are stated**, with the sample size in the title and method keywords covering cluster-robust standard errors and a multiplicative model. **Eighth, one stylistic observation was measured**: the registry description field holds the version change note rather than a study abstract, beginning with a version number and a manuscript version, so what this version changed and what the study is are two different fields and only the former is filled in; **this entry records that without judging it**. **Ninth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover microinsurance institutions and publications, actuarial data for microinsurance, an open microinsurance management system, global health and development indicators, synthetic claims data and a provenance framework in which a machine may not sign off, **while this entry supplies a version update that changes only the presentation layer, states that the analytical inputs are byte-identical, verifies input checksums before drawing and refuses other data vintages, retains superseded artefacts, and writes down a numbering and specification difference together with its result. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled provenance framework and the pooled microinsurance institution entries**; **five practices transfer directly: state both what changed and what did not; verify input fingerprints before drawing or deriving anything; retain superseded scripts and outputs and label them as the previous record; provide a mapping table when file names and paper numbering diverge; and when a specification difference is found, write it down together with the result under both variants**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the archive was not downloaded** — not unpacked, no dataset or script read and no model or figure recomputed — **so no claim is made about the number of schemes, the number of countries, the reported coefficient of determination or any other figure**, everything stated here coming from the record description and metadata. **Second, the assertion that the files are byte-identical was not verified**, which would require downloading two versions and comparing them, nor was whether the manifest really covers sixty-five files; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, the actual changelog content was not verified. Fourth, the scope and results of the numerical-claims audit script were not verified, nor was the claim that the undecomposed and decomposed specifications give the same result.** **Fifth, whether the study has been published, where, and which review round this deposit corresponds to were not verified.** **Sixth, the author identity and affiliation were not verified**, the record giving a single name. **Seventh, how the scheme and country counts were arrived at was not verified. Eighth, the licence is a Creative Commons attribution licence, and whether the underlying scheme registry carries separate third-party rights was not verified. Ninth, on the window: the record was created 2026-09-08, inside the thaw window, so there is no window exception to declare. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the package is research replication material and must not be treated as an assessment of the viability of any insurance scheme.**
